sloka: यस्मादनपराधं त्वं सहायं मम जघ्निवान् ।तस्मात्तवापि पापिष्ठ प्रदास्यामि प्रतिक्रियाम् ।। ७.६५.१६ ॥
transliteration: yasmādanaparādhaṁ tvaṁ sahāyaṁ mama jaghnivān ।tasmāttavāpi pāpiṣṭha pradāsyāmi pratikriyām ।। 7.65.16 ॥

translations.english: The demon declared, "Because you have killed my innocent companion, O most sinful one, I will therefore give you retaliation."
